items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Joe Glaser has a piece of it

ctx.x: Shaw was booking on several things and they'd send me what it was and then after when I played the engagement, here would come a guy up, I'm supposed to get a hundred dollars, and he would show it in black and white where the agency promised him. They wouldn't get it in front, you know, but this guy was responsible for getting the engagement, but they had a split commission or something, (inaudible). After I called the hand I found out (inaudible). When you're around you need help every kind of way, and I think I…
Plus he had a protector, Gladys. Gladys protected the Hamp's interest and her own too, because his interests were hers.
